_notes: Slides come from hero_slides_alt, the published design. hero_slides holds three test rows ("sss", "ssssss") and is deliberately ignored.
The live site rotates five slides; the dump holds four published alt slides. The fifth is missing at the source, not dropped here.
Descriptions were HTML in the dump and are reduced to plain text: the block renders a single line of supporting copy.
Card copy is written for the rebuild — the legacy cards were icons with labels only.
